rules.message: Grain<TState> is the legacy state model. The build gives no warning for it.
rules.fix: In a new grain, derive from Grain and inject [PersistentState("name", "store")] IPersistentState<T>. In an existing grain, keep it and suppress with the reason: a move can change the storage key.
match: public sealed class CounterGrain : Grain<CounterState>, ICounterGrain
nomatch: public sealed class CounterGrain : Grain, ICounterGrain
public class AccountGrain : JournaledGrain<AccountState, AccountEvent>, IAccountGrain

rules.message: RegisterTimer is obsolete since Orleans 8.2 (CS0618). Its callback interleaves with grain calls.
rules.fix: Use this.RegisterGrainTimer(callback, state, new GrainTimerCreationOptions { DueTime, Period }). Set Interleave = true to keep the old behavior of a migrated timer.
nomatch: this.RegisterGrainTimer(FlushAsync, new GrainTimerCreationOptions { DueTime = due, Period = period });

rules.message: ConfigureAwait(false) in grain code moves the rest of the method off the grain scheduler, so two threads can change the state at once (ORLEANS0014).
rules.fix: Write a plain await in grain code. Keep ConfigureAwait(false) only in a library class that no grain calls on its scheduler, and suppress with that reason.

rules.message: SiloHostBuilder, ClientBuilder, and ConfigureApplicationParts are Orleans 3.x APIs. They do not compile on Orleans 7 or later.
rules.fix: On Orleans 7 or later, use builder.UseOrleans(...) or builder.UseOrleansClient(...) on the host builder. In a 3.x code base, keep the code and suppress with the reason.

rules.message: TestClusterBuilder with configurator classes is the older test host. ISiloBuilderConfigurator is Orleans 3.x and does not compile on 7 or later.
rules.fix: In a new test class, use new InProcessTestClusterBuilder(1) with ConfigureSilo((options, silo) => ...). Keep existing test classes.

rules.message: A floating Orleans version changes the silo with a restore, without a commit. Silos of one cluster can then run different versions.
rules.fix: Set one fixed version for all Microsoft.Orleans packages in Directory.Packages.props, for example 10.4.2. For existing code, pin the version that restores today.
